[I. DUKA-PAṬṬHĀNAṂ. I. HETU-DUKAṂ.] [Anulomaṃ.] 1. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho; adosaṃ paṭicca alobho amoho; amohaṃ paṭicca alobho adoso. Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho; mohaṃ paṭicca lobho; dosaṃ paṭicca moho; mohaṃ paṭicca doso. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 2. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 3. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) [page 002] 2 Hetudukaṃ. . . . Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho sampayuttakā ca khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 4. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . pe . . . 5. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetū khandhe paṭicca hetū. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca hetū. 6. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā hetū ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā hetu ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā. 7. Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Alobhañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca adoso amoho . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobhañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho, dosañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe alobhañ ca vatthuñ ca paṭicca adoso amoho . . . pe . . . 8. Hetuñ ca na hetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca hetuñ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Dve khandhe ca hetuñ ca paṭicca dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuñ ca hetuñ ca paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. [page 003] Anekapaccayā. 3 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] 9. Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca alobhañ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā adoso amoho cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve khandhe ca alobhañ ca paṭicca dve khandhā adoso amoho cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca lobhañ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . pe . . . dve khandhe . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuñ ca alobhañ ca paṭicca adoso amoho sampayuttakā ca khandhā . . . pe . . . Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā . . . (rūpaṃ chaḍḍetvā arūpe yeva nava pañhā) . . . adhipatipaccayā . . . (paṭisandhi natthi, paripuṇṇaṃ). Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca . . . pe . . . mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ, upādā rūpaṃ (idaṃ ninnānaṃ) . . . anantarapaccayā . . . samanantarapaccayā . . . sahajātapaccayā . . . (sabbe mahābhūtā yāva asaññasattā) . . . aññamaññapaccayā . . . nissayapaccayā . . . upanissayapaccayā . . . purejātapaccayā . . . āsevanapaccayā . . . (dvīsu paṭisandhi natthi) . . . kammapaccayā . . . vipākapaccayā . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . avigatapaccayā . . . [page 004] 4 Hetudukaṃ. Hetuyā nava, sabbattha nava, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava:-- evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ. Anulomaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. [Paccaniyaṃ.] 4. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā. Ahetukaṃ nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . pe . . . bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . pe . . . 5. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetudhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā. Vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho. 2. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nārammaṇapaccayā. Hetuṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 4. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nārammaṇapaccayā. Nahetū khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . (sabbe mahābhūtā) . . . 8. Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nārammaṇapaccayā. Hetuñ ca nahetū ca khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . nādhipatipaccayā . . . (paripuṇṇaṃ) . . . nānantarapaccayā . . . nasamanantarapaccayā . . . na aññamaññapaccayā . . . na upanissayapaccayā . . . 1. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. [page 005] Napurejātapaccayavāro. Arūpaṃ. 5 Arūpe alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho, mohaṃ paṭicca lobho . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 2. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe hetuṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā khandhā. Hetuṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 3. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe alobhaṃ paṭicca adoso amoho sampayuttakā ca khandhā . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobhaṃ paṭicca moho sampayuttakā ca khandhā . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 4. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā. Dve khandhe paṭicca dve khandhā. Nahetū khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 5. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe nahetū khandhe paṭicca hetū. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 6. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā hetū ca; dve khandhe . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 7. Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe alobhañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca adoso amoho, . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . arūpe lobhañ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca moho . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 8. Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati napurejātapaccayā. [page 006] 6 Hetudukaṃ. Arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca hetuñ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā . . . pe . . . dve khandhe . . . pe . . . nahetū khandhe ca hetuñ ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 9. Hetuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā uppajjanti napurejātapaccayā. Arūpe nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca alobhaṃ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā adoso amoho ca; . . . pe . . . dve khandhe . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca lobhañ ca paṭicca tayo khandhā moho ca; . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 1. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati napacchājātapaccayā: . . . pe . . . nāsevanapaccayā . . . pe . . . 2. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā. Hetuṃ paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. 4. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā. Nahetū khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. Bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ. 8. Heṭuñ ca nahetuñ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nakammapaccayā. Hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe paṭicca sampayuttakā cetanā. 1. Hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu dhammo uppajjati navipākapaccayā: . . . pe . . . 4. Nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu dhammo uppajjati nāhārapaccayā. Bāhiraṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca tayo mahābhūtā. [page 007] Paccaniyaṃ. 7 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] Mahābhūte paṭicca kaṭattā-rūpaṃ upādā-rūpaṃ . . . pe . . . . . . na indriyapaccayā . . . Bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . pe . . . Mahābhūte paṭicca upādā-rūpaṃ asaññasattānaṃ. Mahābhūte paṭicca rūpajīvitindriyaṃ. . . . najhānapaccayā . . . Pañcaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ . . . pe . . . bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . pe . . . . . . namaggapaccayā . . . Ahetukaṃ nahetuṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ . . . pe . . . . . . nasampayuttapaccayā . . . navippayuttapaccayā . . . (napurejātasadisaṃ, arūpe yeva.) . . . . . . nonatthipaccayā . . . . . . novigatapaccayā . . . Nahetuyā dve, nakamme tīṇi, nārammaṇe tīṇi, navipāke nava, nādhipatiyā nava, nāhāre ekaṃ, nānantare tīṇi, na-indriye ekaṃ, nasamanantare tīṇi, najhāne ekaṃ, na-aññamaññe tīṇi, namagge ekaṃ, na-upanissaye tīṇi, nasampayutte tīṇi, napurejāte nava, navippayutte nava, napacchājāte nava, nonatthiyā tīṇi, nāsevane nava. novigate tīṇi:-- evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ. Paccaniyaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. [page 008] 8 Hetudukaṃ. Hetupaccayā, nārammaṇe nāsevane nava, tīṇi, nakamme tīṇi, nādhipatiyā nava, navipāke nava, nānantare tīṇi, nasampayutte tīṇi, (saṃkhittaṃ) navippayutte nava, na upanissaye tīṇi, nonatthiyā tīṇi, napurejāte nava, novigate tīṇi. napacchājāte nava, Anulomapaccaniyaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. Nahetupaccayā, ārammaṇe indriye dve, dve, jhāne dve, anantare dve (saṃkhittaṃ), magge ekaṃ, kamme dve, sampayutte dve (saṃkhittaṃ), vipāke ekaṃ, āhāre dve, avigate dve. Paccaniyānulomaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. (Sahajātavāro pi paṭiccavārasadiso; paccayavāro pi nissayavāro pi paṭiccavārasadisā yeva pañhā. Mahābhūtesu niṭṭhitesu vatthuṃ paccayāti kātabbaṃ. Pañcāyatanāni anulome pi paccaniye pi yathā labbhanti tathā kātabbā. Saṃsaṭṭhavāro pi sampayuttavāro pi paripuṇṇā. Rūpaṃ natthi, arūpam eva.) [Anulomaṃ.] 1. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Alobho adosassa amohassa hetupaccayena paccayo . . . [page 009] Ārammaṇavāro. 9 (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobho mohassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Doso mohassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 2. Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Hetu sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 3. Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Alobho adosassa amohassa sampayuttakānañ ca khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ) . . . Lobho mohassa . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . 1. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuṃ ārabbha hetū khandhā uppajjanti. 2. Hetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuṃ ārabbha nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. 3. Hetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuṃ ārabbha hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. 4. Nahetu dhammo nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati. Ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ, nibbāṇaṃ . . . Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa phalassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā nahetū pahīnakilese paccavekkhanti, [page 010] 10 Hetudukaṃ. [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] vikkhambhitakilese, pubbe samudācinne kilese jānanti, cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ, nahetū khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena nahetucittasamaṃgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Ākāsānañcāyatanakiriyaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanakiriyassa, ākiñcaññāyatanakiriyaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakiriyassa, rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Nahetū khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. 5. Nahetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ datvā . . . (paṭhamagamanaṃ yeva. Āvajjanā natthi. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassāti idaṃ natthi). 6. Nahetu dhammo hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ . . . uposathakammaṃ taṃ paccavekkhati, taṃ ārabbha hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā upajjanti . . . (tatthatatthaṭṭhitena imaṃ kātabbaṃ dutiyagamanasadisaṃ). 7. Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha hetū uppajjanti. [page 011] Adhipativāro. 11 8. Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā nahetussa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha nahetū khandhā uppajjanti. 9. Hetu ca nahetu ca dhammā hetussa ca nahetussa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Hetuñ ca sampayuttake ca khandhe ārabbha hetū ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. 1. Hetu dhammo hetussa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati: -- hetuṃ garuṃ katvā hetū uppajjanti.
